tables.name: product_questions
tables.purpose: Stores every shopper-submitted question and the merchant's answer, along with the lifecycle status that controls storefront visibility.

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify numeric product ID this question belongs to

columns.name: shopper_identifier
columns.purpose: Logged-in customer ID or guest token supplied by the widget

columns.name: failure_reason
columns.purpose: Records error message when a workflow transition fails

transitions.trigger: Merchant submits an answer via the admin answer endpoint
transitions.action: sql_update sets answer_text and answered_at, status becomes answered

transitions.trigger: Merchant sets visibility_decision=published on an answered question
transitions.action: sql_update sets status to published and visibility_decided_at

transitions.trigger: Merchant sets visibility_decision=rejected on an answered question
transitions.action: sql_update sets status to rejected and visibility_decided_at

transitions.trigger: Merchant edits the answer on a published question, reverting to answered
transitions.action: sql_update overwrites answer_text, sets answered_at, clears visibility_decided_at, status reverts to answered

transitions.trigger: Merchant sets visibility_decision=rejected on a pending question
transitions.action: sql_update sets status to rejected and visibility_decided_at

widget.purpose: Accept a shopper's question for a specific product and store it as pending for merchant review.
Return a cursor-paginated list of published questions and answers for a specific product page.

responseShape.questions: { id: string, question_text: string, answer_text: string, created_at: string }[]

admin.purpose: Return a paginated, filterable, searchable list of all questions for the merchant to review.

responseShape.items: { id: string, product_external_id: string, shopper_identifier: string|null, question_text: string, answer_text: string|null, status: string, answered_at: string|null, visibility_decided_at: string|null, created_at: string }[]

admin.purpose: Record the merchant's answer for a pending question and transition it to answered status.
Overwrite the merchant's answer on any non-rejected question and revert it to answered status.
Set a question's visibility to published or rejected, controlling whether it appears on the storefront.
Permanently remove a question and its answer from the system.

sweep-product-questions.description: Sweep stale running-equivalent rows from the product_questions workflow table every 10 minutes.

steps.purpose: Sweep any product_questions rows stuck in a transitional state
Record how many rows were swept

postconditions: No product_questions row remains stuck in a transitional state longer than 10 minutes
edgeCases: No stale rows — sweptIds is an empty array; log records zero; no error.

submit-question.description: Store a shopper's product question as pending, making it available for merchant review.

steps.purpose: Null-defend shopper identifier from request body (R3 pattern)
Sanitize question text — strip null bytes from external input
Parse product_external_id to BIGINT-safe number
Validate that question text is non-empty after sanitization
Persist the new question with pending status
steps.template: INSERT INTO product_questions (product_external_id, shopper_identifier, question_text, status, created_at) VALUES (${productIdNumeric}, ${safeShopperIdentifier}, ${safeQuestionText}, 'pending', now()) RETURNING id, status

steps.purpose: Record submission for observability
Return the new question id and pending status

postconditions: Exactly one product_questions row inserted with status=pending
No duplicate-suppression — two identical question texts for the same product produce two rows
edgeCases: Empty question_text after sanitization — rejected with 400 before any DB write.
shopper_identifier is null (guest widget load) — stored as NULL without error.

list-questions-storefront.description: Return cursor-paginated published questions and answers for a specific product page.

steps.purpose: Parse and clamp page_size to 1–50
Parse product_external_id to numeric
Decode cursor into (cursor_created_at, cursor_id) or nulls when absent
steps.expression: cursor ? (() => { try { const p = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(cursor, 'base64url').toString('utf8')); return { cursorCreatedAt: p.created_at, cursorId: p.id }; } catch { return { cursorCreatedAt: null, cursorId: null }; } })() : { cursorCreatedAt: null, cursorId: null }

steps.purpose: Fetch one page of published questions for this product using keyset cursor
steps.template: SELECT id, question_text, answer_text, created_at FROM product_questions WHERE product_external_id = ${productIdNumeric} AND status = 'published' AND (${cursorCreatedAt}::timestamptz IS NULL OR (created_at, id::text) < (${cursorCreatedAt}::timestamptz, ${cursorId})) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ${fetchLimit}

steps.purpose: Count total published questions for this product for total_count
steps.template: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM product_questions WHERE product_external_id = ${productIdNumeric} AND status = 'published'

steps.purpose: Determine whether there is a next page
Trim the extra sentinel row used for next-page detection
Build next_cursor from last returned row when a next page exists
steps.expression: hasNextPage ? Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ created_at: questions[questions.length - 1].created_at, id: questions[questions.length - 1].id })).toString('base64url') : null

steps.purpose: Return the published questions page with cursor and total count

postconditions: Only status=published rows are returned; the status filter is enforced server-side
Empty list with total_count=0 returned when no published questions exist for the product
next_cursor is null when no further pages exist
edgeCases: Product has no published questions — pageRows is empty; total_count=0; next_cursor=null; no error.
Malformed or tampered cursor — try/catch decode falls back to nulls, treating as first page.
Rejected questions — server-side WHERE status='published' prevents any leakage regardless of caller-supplied params.

list-questions-admin.description: Return a paginated, filterable, searchable list of all questions for the merchant review dashboard.

steps.purpose: Null-defend all optional filters
steps.expression: ({ safeStatus: statusFilter ?? null, safeProductId: productExternalIdFilter ? Number(productExternalIdFilter) : null, safeSearch: searchText ? searchText.replace(/\u0000/g, '') : null, safeSort: ['created_at', 'product_external_id'].includes(sortBy ?? '') ? sortBy : 'created_at' })

steps.purpose: Fetch paginated questions with optional status, product, and full-text search filters
steps.template: SELECT id, product_external_id, shopper_identifier, question_text, answer_text, status, answered_at, visibility_decided_at, created_at FROM product_questions WHERE (${safeStatus}::text IS NULL OR status = ${safeStatus}) AND (${safeProductId}::bigint IS NULL OR product_external_id = ${safeProductId}) AND (${safeSearch}::text IS NULL OR question_text ILIKE '%' || ${safeSearch} || '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN ${safeSort} = 'product_external_id' THEN product_external_id::text ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN ${safeSort} = 'created_at' OR ${safeSort} IS NULL THEN created_at ELSE NULL END DESC

steps.purpose: Return paginated questions list

postconditions: All statuses may appear in the result; the merchant can filter by any single status
Full-text search is case-insensitive ILIKE on question_text
Sort defaults to created_at DESC when sort_by is absent or invalid
edgeCases: No questions match the filter combination — paginate() returns items=[], total=0; no error.
Invalid sort_by value — normalized to 'created_at' before use; no SQL injection risk.

answer-question.description: Record the merchant's answer for a pending question and transition it to answered status.

steps.purpose: Sanitize answer text — strip null bytes
Reject empty answer text before attempting claim
Attempt workflow claim from pending to answered and apply answer
steps.expression: await workflow.attempt('product_questions', questionId, { from: 'pending', to: 'answered' }, async (row) => { const updated = await sql`UPDATE product_questions SET answer_text = ${safeAnswerText}, answered_at = now(), status = 'answered' WHERE id = ${questionId} RETURNING id, status`; return updated[0]; })

steps.purpose: Return not-found when claim returned null (wrong state or missing row)

ifTrue.purpose: Return 404 when question not found or not in pending state

body.error: question not found or not in pending status

ifFalse.purpose: Return the updated question id and answered status

postconditions: question status is answered after success
answer_text and answered_at are set on the row
Only pending questions may be answered via this endpoint
edgeCases: Question already answered or in another state — workflow.attempt returns null; 404 returned to caller.
Two admin sessions POST simultaneously — workflow.attempt races on the claim; one wins and the other gets null; no duplicate state written.
Deleted question id — workflow.attempt finds no matching row; returns null; 404 returned.

edit-answer.description: Overwrite the merchant's answer on any non-rejected question and revert it to answered status, requiring a new publish decision.

steps.purpose: Sanitize answer text — strip null bytes
Reject empty answer text before touching DB
Fetch the current question row to validate it exists and is not rejected
steps.template: SELECT id, status FROM product_questions WHERE id = ${questionId}

steps.purpose: Return 404 when question not found
Reject edit attempts on rejected questions
Atomically overwrite answer and revert status to answered for answered or published questions
steps.template: UPDATE product_questions SET answer_text = ${safeAnswerText}, answered_at = now(), status = 'answered', visibility_decided_at = NULL WHERE id = ${questionId} AND status IN ('answered', 'published') RETURNING id, status

steps.purpose: Record edit for observability
steps.message: answer edited, question reverted to answered

steps.purpose: Return updated question id and answered status

postconditions: question status is answered after success regardless of prior state
visibility_decided_at is cleared so a fresh publish decision is required
edgeCases: Published question edited — status reverts to answered; it disappears from storefront until re-published.
Concurrent edit calls — sql_claim's atomic UPDATE ensures last write wins; no duplicate rows.
Pending question edited via PUT — pre-flight status check rejects it via 409 or the claim returns zero rows via throw; caller receives an error.

set-question-visibility.description: Publish or reject an answered question, controlling whether it appears on the storefront.

steps.purpose: Validate visibility_decision is one of the two allowed values
Return 400 when visibility_decision is not a valid value
Fetch the current question row to validate it exists and has an answer when publishing
steps.template: SELECT id, status, answer_text FROM product_questions WHERE id = ${questionId}

steps.purpose: Return 404 when question not found
Block publishing a question that has no answer text

ifTrue.purpose: Reject publish attempt when answer is missing

body.error: only answered questions with answer text may be published

steps.purpose: Block visibility change on already-rejected questions

ifTrue.purpose: Cannot change visibility of a rejected question

steps.purpose: Atomically transition the question to the decided visibility state
steps.template: UPDATE product_questions SET status = ${validDecision}, visibility_decided_at = now() WHERE id = ${questionId} AND status = 'answered' RETURNING id, status

steps.purpose: Record visibility decision for observability
Return the question id and new status

postconditions: Published questions appear on the storefront from the next GET call
Rejected questions never appear on storefront and cannot be republished
Only answered questions may transition to published or rejected
edgeCases: Merchant attempts to publish a question with no answer — blocked with 409 before the claim.
Pending question targeted — sql_claim WHERE status='answered' returns zero rows; throws; caller receives error.
Already-rejected question targeted — pre-flight check blocks with 409.

remove-question.description: Permanently delete a question and its answer from the system.

steps.purpose: Check whether the question exists before deletion
steps.template: SELECT id FROM product_questions WHERE id = ${questionId}

steps.purpose: Return 404 when no matching row found

postconditions: Row is permanently removed; any concurrent answer or visibility request for the same id will find no row
edgeCases: Concurrent answer/visibility request races the delete — those requests will find no row and return 404; no orphan state.
Deletion of a published question — immediately stops storefront GET from returning it; no further action needed.

platformGaps.gap: No Shopify identity token is delivered to the storefront widget at mount time that could reliably identify the logged-in customer across sessions without a Shopify Customer Account API integration.
platformGaps.mitigation: The widget accepts an optional shopper_identifier supplied by the theme liquid (e.g. {{ customer.id }} rendered into the App Block attributes) and stores it as TEXT; absence is stored as NULL without error.
platformGaps.uxImplication: Guest shoppers have no persistent identity linkage; their questions appear in the admin with a null shopper identifier.

uxExpectations.storefront: The widget renders a paginated list of published Q&A pairs directly below the product description, with a compact inline form at the bottom that lets any visitor submit a new question; after submission the form shows a 'thanks, under review' confirmation and does not refresh the Q&A list.
uxExpectations.admin: The merchant dashboard prioritizes the pending-questions queue as the landing view, with a status-filter tab bar (Pending / Answered / Published / Rejected) and per-row action buttons (Answer, Publish, Reject, Delete) that operate without a full page reload; answered questions surface an edit-answer affordance alongside the publish/reject buttons.

edgeCases: Merchant attempts to publish a question that has no answer_text — the visibility recipe blocks the transition with 409 before the sql_claim runs, preserving the answered status.

A published question's answer is overwritten via PUT /questions/answer — the edit-answer recipe's sql_claim atomically reverts status to answered and clears visibility_decided_at, removing it from storefront until re-published.

Storefront GET is called for a product with no published questions — the cursor SELECT returns zero rows; count SELECT returns 0; response is questions=[], next_cursor=null, total_count=0 with status 200.

A question is deleted while a concurrent visibility or answer request is in flight — the concurrent request's sql_claim or sql_select finds no matching row and returns a 404 or no-op; no orphan state is created because all writes require the row to exist.

Two admin sessions submit answers for the same pending question simultaneously — workflow.attempt races on the internal claim transition; one succeeds and the question moves to answered; the other returns null and receives a 404; no duplicate answer rows are written.
A rejected question is queried via the storefront GET — the server-side WHERE status = 'published' filter excludes it unconditionally; no caller-supplied parameter can override this predicate.
